title: 1. What is Threat Intelligence (CTI)?
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L21: Threat Intelligence & MITRE ATT&CK: 1. What is Threat Intelligence (CTI)?.

blocks.text: Definition: CTI is data that has been collected, processed, and analyzed into actionable intelligence to support decisions that reduce risk.
CTI ≠ threat feed. Feeding raw IOCs into a SIEM without analysis gives you data, not intelligence.

items: Detect — find attackers using known TTPs in your environment
Respond — understand attacker motive, capability, next move during an incident
Predict — know which actors target your sector → prioritize defense
Strategic — inform board / executive decisions on investment and risk appetite
